# Eurex Reference Data API: full context for AI agents

One file: the instructions (ai.md), the tool list and the GraphQL schema. Generated by scripts/build_ai_assets.py.

# Eurex Reference Data API: instructions for AI agents

Everything an AI assistant needs to answer questions with the Eurex GraphQL reference-data API. Plain text on purpose: read it top to bottom, then use the API.

**For users:** give your assistant this prompt. It works as is, with the shared demo key.

```
Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ViktorHD/eurex-api/main/ai.md and use it to answer my questions with the Eurex API. Use the demo key from that page.
```

Hint: the demo key is shared by everyone, so it can hit rate limits at busy times. For regular use get your own free key on the [Deutsche Börse developer portal](https://console.developer.deutsche-boerse.com/apis/50247b4e-dae5-4db7-be15-27bd5b17a082) and add it to the prompt: "My API key (header X-DBP-APIKEY): <your key>".

No tool that can send HTTP requests? Ask the assistant for a query and run it in the API Explorer (https://viktorhd.github.io/eurex-api/).

## 1. Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | `https://api.developer.deutsche-boerse.com/eurex-prod-graphql/` |
| Method | `POST`, header `Content-Type: application/json` |
| Authentication | Header `X-DBP-APIKEY: <key>`. Use the key the user gave you. If they gave none, use the shared **demo key** `68cdafd2-c5c1-49be-8558-37244ab4f513` (the one the public Explorer uses). Never invent or guess a key. |
| Body | `{"query": "...", "variables": {...}}` (`variables` optional) |
| Content | Eurex *reference data*: products, contracts, trading hours, holidays, tick rules, TES parameters, settlement prices. No live market data or order books. |
| Access | Read-only queries. There are no mutations. |

## 2. Rules for the agent

1. **Never guess names.** Field and type names are case sensitive (`ProductInfos`, `Contracts`, `ExpirationDate`). If unsure, run the introspection query in section 4 and use what it returns.
2. **Filter by `Product`** for `Contracts`, `FlexibleContracts` and `SettlementPrices`. Without it the result is huge and the request may time out or be cut off.
3. **Select only the fields you need.** Smaller answers are faster and cheaper to read.
4. **Find the product code first** when the user gives a name, ISIN or underlying (recipe 1 in section 6). Product codes are short, e.g. `FESX` (Euro STOXX 50 futures) and `OESX` (its options).
5. **Several datasets in one request:** put several root fields in one query instead of making several calls.
6. **Report the validity date.** Every dataset returns a `date`; mention it when it matters ("as of 2026-10-09").
7. **Do not invent data.** If the API returns nothing or an error, say so. Do not fill gaps from memory: contract specifications and trading hours change, and the API is the source of truth.
8. **Cannot send POST requests?** Give the user the finished query and tell them to run it in the API Explorer.
9. Prefer the user's own key over the demo key. Do not store or repeat a user's own key in your answers. If the demo key is rate limited (HTTP 429), tell the user once that it is shared and that a free personal key from the developer portal avoids this.

## 3. First request

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.developer.deutsche-boerse.com/eurex-prod-graphql/ \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-DBP-APIKEY: YOUR_KEY' \
  -d '{"query":"{ ProductInfos(filter:{Product:{eq:\"FESX\"}}) { date data { Product Name ProductISIN Currency ContractSize TickSize TickValue } } }"}'
```

Response shape: every dataset is a root field that returns an object with the validity `date` and a list `data`. When a dataset is paged, `pageInfo` sits next to them.

```
{ "data": { "ProductInfos": {
    "date": "2026-10-09",
    "data": [ { "Product": "FESX", "Name": "...", "Currency": "EUR" } ],
    "pageInfo": { "hasNextPage": false, "endCursor": null }
} } }
```

## 4. Discover the schema (introspection)

Standard GraphQL introspection works. The list of datasets (root queries) and their arguments:

```
{ __schema { queryType { fields { name description args { name type { name kind } } type { name kind ofType { name kind } } } } } }
```

The fields of one result type (use the type name from the result above):

```
{ __type(name: "Contract") { fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } }
```

The filter input types show the exact operators available per field. Look up the type name from the `filter` argument of the root field, then: `{ __type(name: "<FilterTypeName>") { inputFields { name type { name } } } }`.

## 5. Datasets (root queries)

| Root query | Content | Useful fields |
|---|---|---|
| `ProductInfos` | Product master data, one row per product | ProductID, Product, Name, ProductISIN, ProductType, ProductTypeCode, ProductLine, LiquidityClass, Currency, ContractSize, TickSize, TickValue, SettlementType, Underlying, UnderlyingISIN |
| `Contracts` | Listed series (futures and options). **Filter by Product.** | Contract, ISIN, ContractDate, ContractCycle, ExpirationDate, FirstTradingDate, LastTradingDate, CallPut, Strike, OptionsDelta, SettlementPrice, SettlementDate |
| `FlexibleContracts` | Flexible (customised) contracts. **Filter by Product.** | ContractID, Contract, ISIN, CallPut, Strike, ExpirationDate, SettlementDate, SettlementPrice, OpenInterest, ExerciseStyle, SettlementType |
| `Expirations` | Expiration calendar per product | ProductID, Product, MasterContract, ExpirationIndex, ExpirationDate |
| `TradingHours` | Trading phases per product | Product, StartContinuousTrading, EndOpeningAuction, EndContinuousTrading, EndClosingAuction, StartTES, EndTES, LTDBook, LTDTES |
| `Holidays` | Exchange holidays per product | Product, Holiday, ExchangeHoliday |
| `TickRules` | Price steps per price band | Product, TradeType, InstrumentType, StartPrice, EndPrice, PriceStep |
| `TESProfiles` | T7 Entry Service (off-book) parameters | Product, TESType, InstrumentType, PriceValidationRule, AllowAutoApproval, AllowBroker, MinLotSize, MinLotSizeNonPrimary, MinExpiryRange, NonDisclosureLimit, TESminStep, MaxTrader, LegPriceEntry |
| `SettlementPrices` | Daily settlement prices. **Filter by Product.** | ContractID, Product, ContractType (e.g. `FLEXIBLE`), PriceType, SettlementPrice, SettlementDate |
| `VendorCodes` | Data-vendor symbols per product | introspect |
| `DeliverableBonds` | Bonds deliverable into fixed income futures | introspect |
| `Enlight`, `EnlightResponders` | EnLight RFQ configuration and responders | introspect |
| `Changelog` | Announced and past changes to the API data | Date, Type, OldValue, NewValue, Description, Query |

The list can grow; the introspection query in section 4 is authoritative.

## 6. Query syntax

Filter:

```
Contracts(filter: { Product: { eq: "FESX" } }) { ... }
TradingHours(filter: { Product: { eq: "FESX" } }) { ... }
```

`eq` is the operator used throughout. Do not assume others (`in`, `ne`, ranges): read the available operators and the value formats (for example dates) from the filter input type with introspection before using them. When in doubt, filter by `Product` and do the rest of the filtering yourself on the returned rows.

Sort (`field` is an enum value without quotes, `order` is `ASC` or `DESC`):

```
Holidays(filter: { Product: { eq: "FESX" } }, sort: { field: Holiday, order: ASC }) { ... }
```

Paging: large results are paged by cursor. Ask for `pageInfo` and pass the cursor back until `hasNextPage` is false:

```
Contracts(filter: { Product: { eq: "OESX" } }, page: { first: 200 }) {
  date
  data { Contract Strike ExpirationDate }
  pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
}
# next page: page: { first: 200, after: "<endCursor>" }
```

Variables:

```
{"query": "query ($p: String) { Holidays(filter: { Product: { eq: $p } }) { date data { Holiday ExchangeHoliday } } }",
 "variables": { "p": "FESX" }}
```

Recipes:

1. **Find a product by name, ISIN or underlying.** Load the product list once (`ProductInfos { data { Product Name ProductISIN ProductType Currency } }`, no filter, about one row per product), then search it yourself (case-insensitive over Product, Name, ProductISIN). Do not guess codes.
2. **Product card in one request:** `ProductInfos`, `TradingHours`, `TickRules`, `TESProfiles` and `Holidays`, each with `filter: { Product: { eq: "FESX" } }`.
3. **Next expirations:** `Expirations(filter: { Product: { eq: "OESX" } })` for the calendar, `Contracts` for the listed series.
4. **Option strikes for one expiry:** `Contracts` with the product filter, select `ContractDate CallPut Strike OptionsDelta`, then group by `ContractDate` yourself.
5. **Is the market open / what are the hours?** `TradingHours` gives the phase times; `Holidays` gives days without trading. State which time zone the data uses only if you have verified it from the data or documentation.
6. **What changed recently?** `Changelog { data { Date Type Description Query } }`; the `Query` field names the affected dataset.

## 7. Errors and limits

| Symptom | Meaning and action |
|---|---|
| HTTP 401 / 403 | Key missing or invalid. Check the header name and value; if the user's own key fails, ask them to verify it. |
| HTTP 429 | Rate limit. Wait for the `Retry-After` seconds (or about 10 s) and retry once; do not hammer the API. |
| HTTP 5xx or timeout | Temporary. Retry later or narrow the query (add filters, fewer fields, `page: { first: N }`). |
| HTTP 200 with `errors` | GraphQL error such as an unknown field. Read `errors[].message`, fix the query, and use introspection instead of guessing. If `data` is also present, the answer is partial: use what is there and say what is missing. |
| Empty `data` list | No match. Check the product code and the filter value; do not conclude that a product does not exist before looking it up in `ProductInfos`. |

## 8. Answering the user

- Answer in plain words first; add a small table when the data is a list.
- Name the product (code and name), the dataset and the validity date you used.
- Show the GraphQL query only if the user asks for it or wants to rerun it.
- Say clearly when something is not available in the API instead of estimating it.

## 9. Answer patterns

Proven ways to answer frequent questions. Dates and times below are Eurex time (Europe/Berlin), the convention of the API Explorer.

| Question | How |
|---|---|
| Next expiration of a product | `Expirations(filter: { Product: { eq: "OESX" } })`; keep rows with `ExpirationDate` today or later, take the earliest. Report date, `ExpirationIndex` and `MasterContract`. |
| Is the product trading now? | `TradingHours` + `Holidays` for the product. Weekend: closed. Today in `Holidays`: holiday. Now inside `StartContinuousTrading`..`EndContinuousTrading`: open. Else inside `StartTES`..`EndTES`: only TES. Else closed. A range that ends before it starts runs over midnight. |
| Tick size at a price | `TickRules` for the product. Use `TradeType` ORDER_BOOK and the simple `InstrumentType` unless asked otherwise; BLOCK without own rules follows the order book. A band covers `StartPrice` up to `EndPrice` (`EndPrice` excluded when the next band starts there, included otherwise; empty `EndPrice` is open ended). A price is valid when it is a whole multiple of `PriceStep`. |
| Minimum TES lot size for the n-th expiry | `TESProfiles` + `Expirations`. `MinExpiryRange` is the expiration index (1 = front expiry) from which a row applies until the next row starts. Use the row with the highest `MinExpiryRange` not above n. |
| Strikes of an option for one expiry | `Contracts` with the product filter; select `ContractDate CallPut Strike OptionsDelta`; keep the wanted `ContractDate`; list unique strikes sorted. |
| Latest settlement price | `SettlementPrices` with the product filter; take the newest `SettlementDate` for the wanted `ContractID` and `PriceType`. Narrow the result; the history is large. |
| Is something changing for a product? | `Changelog`; keep entries whose `Description`, `OldValue`, `NewValue` or `Query` mention the product or dataset; newest first. |

## 10. Tools instead of raw GraphQL

If your client supports MCP, connect the MCP server instead of writing queries. Local: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/ViktorHD/eurex-api eurex-mcp` (set `EUREX_API_KEY` for your own key). Remote: add the URL `https://YOUR-APP-HOST/mcp` and send your key as header `X-DBP-APIKEY`; without one the shared demo key is used with a per-address limit. Tools: `search_products`, `get_product`, `get_market_status`, `get_tick_size`, `get_expirations`, `get_holidays`, `list_contracts`, `get_strikes`, `get_tes_thresholds`, `get_settlement_prices`, `get_changes`, `get_schema`, `run_graphql`. They apply the rules and patterns above. Tool definitions for the Claude and OpenAI APIs are in `ai/claude_tools.json` and `ai/openai_tools.json`; an OpenAPI document is in `ai/openapi.json`. The full schema is in `schema.graphql` and everything in one file in `llms-full.txt` (both once generated).

## 11. More

- API Explorer: https://viktorhd.github.io/eurex-api/
- Official description: https://www.eurex.com/ex-en/data/free-reference-data-api
- Notebooks with working queries: https://github.com/ViktorHD/eurex-api/tree/main/notebooks

## Tools (MCP server `python -m eurex_mcp.server`, REST `/api/v1/tools/<name>`)

- `get_api_info()`: Describe the Eurex reference-data API and this tool set: endpoint, datasets, whether the shared demo key is in use. Call first if unsure what is available.
- `search_products(query: string, limit?: integer)`: Find Eurex products by code, name, ISIN or underlying (case-insensitive, all words must match). Returns code, name, ISIN, type and currency.
- `get_product(product: string)`: Product card in one call: master data, trading hours with live status, tick rules, TES profiles, next holidays and upcoming expirations.
- `get_market_status(product: string, at?: string)`: Is a product trading now (or at a given time)? Computes open / tes / closed / holiday from TradingHours and Holidays. Times are Europe/Berlin.
- `get_tick_size(product: string, price?: number, trade_type?: string, instrument_type?: string)`: Tick (price step) rules of a product: the step that applies at a price, whether the price is on the grid, and the nearest valid prices.
- `get_expirations(product: string, upcoming_only?: boolean, limit?: integer)`: Expiration calendar of a product (upcoming by default), with the expiration index and master contract.
- `get_holidays(product: string, upcoming_only?: boolean, limit?: integer)`: Exchange holidays of a product (upcoming by default).
- `list_contracts(product: string, contract_date?: string, call_put?: string, limit?: integer)`: Listed series of a product (futures or options), optionally narrowed by contract date (e.g. 2026-12 or 202612) and call/put.
- `get_strikes(product: string, contract_date?: string)`: Option strikes per contract date of an options product: sorted unique strikes, split into calls and puts.
- `get_tes_thresholds(product: string, tes_type?: string, instrument_type?: string, limit?: integer)`: T7 Entry Service (TES, off-book) minimum lot sizes and non-disclosure limits per expiration, from TESProfiles and Expirations.
- `get_settlement_prices(product: string, contract_id?: string, price_type?: string, since?: string, limit?: integer)`: Settlement price history of a product, newest first. Narrow with contract_id, price_type or since to keep the answer small.
- `get_changes(mentions?: string, since?: string, limit?: integer)`: Announced and past changes to the API data (Changelog), newest first; optionally only entries that mention a product code or text.
- `get_schema(type_name?: string)`: Introspect the GraphQL schema. Without type_name: all datasets (root queries) with arguments. With type_name: the fields, input fields or enum values of that type. Use it instead of guessing names.
- `run_graphql(query: string, variables?: object, max_chars?: integer)`: Escape hatch: run a read-only GraphQL query against the Eurex API and get the raw result. Contracts, FlexibleContracts and SettlementPrices must be filtered by Product. Prefer the specific tools.

## GraphQL schema (SDL)

```graphql
# Generated by scripts/export_schema.py from the live introspection. Do not edit by hand.

"""List all queries provided by this service"""
type Query {
  """Contracts query provides basic information about instruments traded on EUREX"""
  Contracts(filter: ContractsFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: ContractsSortInput): ContractsResponse
  """Expirations query provides expirations information on contract level"""
  Expirations(filter: ExpirationsFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: ExpirationsSortInput): ExpirationsResponse
  """TradingHours query provides information about on-book and off-book trading hours per product in local Frankfurt time"""
  TradingHours(filter: TradingHoursFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: TradingHoursSortInput): TradingHoursResponse
  """The table provides a set of settlement prices for standard and flexible contracts listed on Eurex. Information is available for the last 5 trading days"""
  SettlementPrices(filter: SettlementPricesFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: SettlementPricesSortInput): SettlementPricesResponse
  """Changelog query provides an overview of changes implemented to the API"""
  Changelog(filter: ChangelogFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: ChangelogSortInput): ChangelogResponse
  """TESProfiles query provides information about TES relevant product configurations"""
  TESProfiles(filter: TESProfilesFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: TESProfilesSortInput): TESProfilesResponse
  """TickRules query provides information about tick rules valid for different traded types and instrument types"""
  TickRules(filter: TickRulesFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: TickRulesSortInput): TickRulesResponse
  """The table provides essential data on the bonds which meet the criteria of eligibility for the deliverable baskets of Eurex’s Fixed Income Government bond futures. The data provided includes bonds key parameters, such as the expiry date and the coupon rate, as well as their respective conversion factors."""
  DeliverableBonds(filter: DeliverableBondsFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: DeliverableBondsSortInput): DeliverableBondsResponse
  """Enlight query provides product configuration for Eurex EnLight service"""
  Enlight(filter: EnlightFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: EnlightSortInput): EnlightResponse
  """VendorCodes query provides vendor specific codes or abbreviations used in the vedor systems for the search or display of Eurex products/contracts"""
  VendorCodes(filter: VendorCodesFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: VendorCodesSortInput): VendorCodesResponse
  """EnlightResponders query provides list of Enlight responders per product"""
  EnlightResponders(filter: EnlightRespondersFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: EnlightRespondersSortInput): EnlightRespondersResponse
  """Holidays query provides product specific trading holidays for the next 2 years"""
  Holidays(filter: HolidaysFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: HolidaysSortInput): HolidaysResponse
  """Table provides an overview of all contracts which were created by Eurex customers (flexible contracts) and persist in Eurex system"""
  FlexibleContracts(filter: FlexibleContractsFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: FlexibleContractsSortInput): FlexibleContractsResponse
  """ProductInfos query provides basic information about products traded on EUREX"""
  ProductInfos(filter: ProductInfosFilter, page: PaginationInput, sort: ProductInfosSortInput): ProductInfosResponse
}

"""Changelog query provides an overview of changes implemented to the API"""
type Changelog {
  """Date of implemented changes"""
  Date: Date
  """Type of change"""
  Type: String
  """Name or content of previuos value"""
  OldValue: String
  """Name or content of new value"""
  NewValue: String
  """Description of the change"""
  Description: String
  """Affected table/query"""
  Query: String
}

"""The sortable fields for the Changelog entity"""
enum ChangelogFieldName {
  Date
  Type
  OldValue
  NewValue
  Description
  Query
}

"""The provided filter for the Changelog entity"""
input ChangelogFilter {
  Date: DateFilter
  Type: StringFilter
  OldValue: StringFilter
  NewValue: StringFilter
  Description: StringFilter
  Query: StringFilter
}

"""The response type of the Changelog entity"""
type ChangelogResponse {
  """Submission date of the data"""
  date: Date
  """list of Changelog items."""
  data: [Changelog]
  """Pagination metadata. Present only when the query was made with a page argument."""
  pageInfo: PageInfo
}

"""
Sorting instruction for Changelog query results. Specifies the field to sort by and the order (ASC or DESC).
Note: Only rows where the sort field contains a non-null value will be included in the response.
Rows with null values in the sort field are automatically filtered out.
"""
input ChangelogSortInput {
  """
  The name of the field to sort by.
  Allowed values: Date, Type, OldValue, NewValue, Description, Query
  """
  field: ChangelogFieldName!
  """The sort order: ASC for ascending, DESC for descending"""
  order: SortOrder!
}

"""Contracts query provides basic information about instruments traded on EUREX"""
type Contracts {
  """ID of the product."""
  ProductID: Int
  """Product symbol."""
  Product: String
  """Future or Option discriminator."""
  ProductLine: String
  """Unique ID used in T7 ETI for trading requests."""
  InstrumentID: Int
  """Eurex’s cross-systems numeric unique internal ID of the contract."""
  ContractID: Int
  """ISIN code related to Eurex’s contracts."""
  ISIN: String
  """Represents a frame for multiple unique contracts with same basic properties, in case of a future product master contract is equal to the standard contract"""
  MasterContract: String
  """Eurex's unique business name of the contract. The Contract represents the key fields of a Contract in a string form. It contains the following key Contract attributes which identify a contract uniquely, separated by spaces: Product symbol or Product ID, Contract Type, Contract Date, Settlement Type, Exercise Style, C/P Indicator, Strike Price and Contract Version Number. Key words definition: SI - Standard Instrument (Regular Contract), FI - Flexible Instrument (Flexible Contract), CS - Cash Settlement, PS - Physical Settlement (Non-Cash), EU - European Exercise Style (Options) and AM - American Exercise Style (Options). The content of this field may change in exceptional circumstances. These include among others - Capital Adjustments, which change the contained strike price or changes of the Trading Calendar, which might change the contained contract date."""
  Contract: String
  """Defines, if this contract based on its contract generation cycle, is considered primary."""
  PrimaryContract: String
  """Indicates expiration type, in the context of which the instrument has been created by the exchange. E.g. yearly, quarterly, monthly etc. expiration types"""
  ContractCycle: String
  """Defines if instrument is a put (P) or call (C)."""
  CallPut: String
  """Contract Strike price."""
  Strike: Float
  """The field contains the original strike price before modifcation of the contract."""
  OriginalStrike: Float
  """Defines the type of settlement for a contract"""
  SettlementType: String
  """Exercise style of a contract"""
  ExerciseStyle: String
  """Identifies variation of the standard instruments due to corporate action."""
  VersionNr: Int
  """Represents the number of capital adjustments applied during the product lifetime"""
  GenerationNr: Int
  """Contract size of a contract"""
  ContractSize: Float
  """Contract size which is going to be settled or delivered"""
  DeliverySize: Float
  """Fraction of contract size which is cash settled in case contract is physically settled"""
  CashFraction: Float
  """Indicates the type of security using ISO 10962 standard."""
  CFI: String
  """First trading day of the contract."""
  FirstTradingDate: Date
  """Date used to identify the instrument (YYYYMMDD) and referring to the main event of derivative contract."""
  ContractDate: Date
  """A symbol to describe the type of ContractDate."""
  ContractDateType: String
  """Last trading day of the contract."""
  LastTradingDate: Date
  """Expiry date of the contract."""
  ExpirationDate: Date
  """Final settlement price fixing date."""
  FinalSettlementDate: Date
  """Previous day’s option delta provided for option instruments only"""
  OptionsDelta: Float
  """Underlying contract for derivatives on derivatives (e.g.: Options on futures)"""
  UnderlyingContract: String
  """Creation date of a contract"""
  CreationDate: Date
  """Date of last capital adjustment applied to contract"""
  CapitalAdjusmentDate: Date
  """Eurex's unique business name of the contract before last capital adjustment"""
  PreviousContract: String
  """Contract size of a contract before last capital adjustment"""
  PreviousContractSize: Float
  """Product symbol before last capital adjustment."""
  PreviousProduct: String
  """Contract strike price before last capital adjustment."""
  PreviousStrike: Float
  """Unadjusted open interest quantity of a contract"""
  OpenInterest: Int
  """Settlement day of a contract, referring to a settlement price"""
  SettlementDate: Date
  """Settlement price of a contract. Provided in clearing notation for variance futures and total return futures instruments"""
  SettlementPrice: Float
}

"""The sortable fields for the Contracts entity"""
enum ContractsFieldName {
  ProductID
  Product
  ProductLine
  InstrumentID
  ContractID
  ISIN
  MasterContract
  Contract
  PrimaryContract
  ContractCycle
  CallPut
  Strike
  OriginalStrike
  SettlementType
  ExerciseStyle
  VersionNr
  GenerationNr
  ContractSize
  DeliverySize
  CashFraction
  CFI
  FirstTradingDate
  ContractDate
  ContractDateType
  LastTradingDate
  ExpirationDate
  FinalSettlementDate
  OptionsDelta
  UnderlyingContract
  CreationDate
  CapitalAdjusmentDate
  PreviousContract
  PreviousContractSize
  PreviousProduct
  PreviousStrike
  OpenInterest
  SettlementDate
  SettlementPrice
}

"""The provided filter for the Contracts entity"""
input ContractsFilter {
  ProductID: IntFilter
  """Requires an equality condition (eq) when page is omitted. Optional when page is provided."""
  Product: StringFilter1
  ProductLine: StringFilter
  InstrumentID: IntFilter
  ContractID: IntFilter
  ISIN: StringFilter
  MasterContract: StringFilter
  Contract: StringFilter
  PrimaryContract: StringFilter
  ContractCycle: StringFilter
  CallPut: StringFilter
  Strike: FloatFilter
  OriginalStrike: FloatFilter
  SettlementType: StringFilter
  ExerciseStyle: StringFilter
  VersionNr: IntFilter
  GenerationNr: IntFilter
  ContractSize: FloatFilter
  DeliverySize: FloatFilter
  CashFraction: FloatFilter
  CFI: StringFilter
  FirstTradingDate: DateFilter
  ContractDate: DateFilter
  ContractDateType: StringFilter
  LastTradingDate: DateFilter
  ExpirationDate: DateFilter
  FinalSettlementDate: DateFilter
  OptionsDelta: FloatFilter
  UnderlyingContract: StringFilter
  CreationDate: DateFilter
  CapitalAdjusmentDate: DateFilter
  PreviousContract: StringFilter
  PreviousContractSize: FloatFilter
  PreviousProduct: StringFilter
  PreviousStrike: FloatFilter
  OpenInterest: IntFilter
  SettlementDate: DateFilter
  SettlementPrice: FloatFilter
}

"""The response type of the Contracts entity"""
type ContractsResponse {
  """Submission date of the data"""
  date: Date
  """list of Contracts items."""
  data: [Contracts]
  """Pagination metadata. Present only when the query was made with a page argument."""
  pageInfo: PageInfo
}

"""
Sorting instruction for Contracts query results. Specifies the field to sort by and the order (ASC or DESC).
Note: Only rows where the sort field contains a non-null value will be included in the response.
Rows with null values in the sort field are automatically filtered out.
"""
input ContractsSortInput {
  """
  The name of the field to sort by.
  Allowed values: ProductID, Product, ProductLine, InstrumentID, ContractID, ISIN, MasterContract, Contract, PrimaryContract, ContractCycle, CallPut, Strike, OriginalStrike, SettlementType, ExerciseStyle, VersionNr, GenerationNr, ContractSize, DeliverySize, CashFraction, CFI, FirstTradingDate, ContractDate, ContractDateType, LastTradingDate, ExpirationDate, FinalSettlementDate, OptionsDelta, UnderlyingContract, CreationDate, CapitalAdjusmentDate, PreviousContract, PreviousContractSize, PreviousProduct, PreviousStrike, OpenInterest, SettlementDate, SettlementPrice
  """

"""Table provides an overview of all contracts which were created by Eurex customers (flexible contracts) and persist in Eurex system"""
type FlexibleContracts {
  """ID of the product."""
  ProductID: Int
  """Product symbol."""
  Product: String
  """Eurex’s cross-systems numeric, unique, internal ID of the contract."""
  ContractID: Int
  """ISIN code related to Eurex’s contracts."""
  ISIN: String
  """Eurex's unique business name of the contract. The Contract represents the key fields of a Contract in a string form. It contains the following key Contract attributes which identify a contract uniquely, separated by spaces: Product symbol or Product ID, Contract Type, Contract Date, Settlement Type, Exercise Style, C/P Indicator, Strike Price and Contract Version Number. Key words definition: SI - Standard Instrument (Regular Contract), FI - Flexible Instrument (Flexible Contract), CS - Cash Settlement, PS - Physical Settlement (Non-Cash), EU - European Exercise Style (Options) and AM - American Exercise Style (Options). The content of this field may change in exceptional circumstances. These include among others - Capital Adjustments, which change the contained strike price or changes of the Trading Calendar, which might change the contained contract date."""
  Contract: String
  """Indicates the type of security using ISO 10962 standard."""
  CFI: String
  """Defines whether contract is a put (P) or call (C)."""
  CallPut: String
  """Exercise style of a contract."""
  ExerciseStyle: String
  """Contracts strike price."""
  Strike: Float
  """Identifies variation of the standard instruments due to corporate action."""
  VersionNr: Int
  """Defines the type of settlement for a contract"""
  SettlementType: String
  """Contract size of a contract during its lifetime"""
  ContractSize: Float
  """Creation date of a contract"""
  CreationDate: Date
  """Expiry date of the contract."""
  ExpirationDate: Date
  """Final settlement price fixing date."""
  FinalSettlementDate: Date
  """Date used to identify the instrument (YYYYMMDD) and referring to the main event during lifetime of derivative contract."""
  ContractDate: Date
  """Date of last capital adjustment applied to contract"""
  CapitalAdjusmentDate: Date
  """Eurex's unique business name of the contract before last capital adjustment"""
  PreviousContract: String
  """Contract size of a contract before last capital adjustment"""
  PreviousContractSize: Float
  """Product symbol before last capital adjustment."""
  PreviousProduct: String
  """Contract strike price before last capital adjustment."""
  PreviousStrike: Float
  """Fraction of contract size which is cash settled in case contract is physically settled"""
  CashFraction: Float
  """Unadjusted open interest quantity of a contract"""
  OpenInterest: Int
  """Settlement day of a contract, referring to a settlement price"""
  SettlementDate: Date
  """Settlement price of a contract. Provided in clearing notation for variance futures and total return futures instruments"""
  SettlementPrice: Float
  """Flexible to Standard contract conversion date"""
  ConversionDate: Date
  """Contract ID of a standard contract which took over the open interest of flexible contract"""
  ConvertedToContractID: Int
}

"""
Pagination metadata returned alongside a paginated result set.
Only present in the response when the query includes a page argument.
"""
type PageInfo {
  """Whether more items exist after the current page."""
  hasNextPage: Boolean!
  """
  Cursor identifying the last item in this page.
  Pass this value as the after argument in the next query to retrieve the next page.
  Null only when the page contains no items.
  """
  endCursor: String
}

"""
Keyset pagination input. Fetches up to `first` items after the cursor `after`.
When `page` is provided on a query, the mandatory equality filter is no longer required.
"""
input PaginationInput {
  """Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 100 if omitted. Maximum is 1000."""
  first: Int
  """
  Opaque keyset cursor obtained from a previous response's pageInfo.endCursor.
  Omit or pass null to start from the beginning of the result set.
  """
  after: String
}

input StringFilter1 {
  ne: String
  has: Boolean
  eq: String
  le: String
  lt: String
  ge: String
  gt: String
  contains: String
  notContains: String
  beginsWith: String
}

"""TESProfiles query provides information about TES relevant product configurations"""
type TESProfiles {
  """TES type valid for the corresponding product and instrument type"""
  TESType: String
  """Minimum number of traded quantity required for a TES trade (non-primary contracts)."""
  MinLotSizeNonPrimary: Int
  """Product symbol"""
  Product: String
  """Instrument type valid for the corresponding product"""
  InstrumentType: String
  """ID of the product"""
  ProductID: Int
  """The lowes possible price graduation for the price of TES trade"""
  TESminStep: Float
  """Defines whether leg price of a complex instrument can be entered by participant or not"""
  LegPriceEntry: String
  """Minimum number of traded quantity required for a TES trade (primary contracts)."""
  MinLotSize: Int
  """Flag to indicate if auto approval is allowed"""
  AllowAutoApproval: String
  """Flag to indicate whether broker trades (i.e. TES trades where the entering participant / firm is involved neither on the buy nor on the sell side) are allowed"""
  AllowBroker: String
  """Non-disclosure limit; by default all TES trades are published in real time; in case the quantity of a TES trade is higher than the non-disclosure limit, the entering participant can decide whether the TES trade is not published."""
  NonDisclosureLimit: Int
  """TES price validation rule which is applied to verify the TES trade when entered to T7."""
  PriceValidationRule: String
  """Minimum expiry range denotes differentiation of TES profiles based on expiration sequence of contracts. Affected contracts can be retrived in Expirations table"""
  MinExpiryRange: Int
  """Maximum number of participants involved on the buy and sell side of a TES trade; a value of 2 indicates that only bi-lateral TES trades are allowed (1 buyer and 1 sell) and a value larger than 2 indicates that bi-lateral and multi-lateral TES trades are allowed."""
  MaxTrader: Int
}

"""The sortable fields for the TESProfiles entity"""
enum TESProfilesFieldName {
  TESType
  MinLotSizeNonPrimary
  Product
  InstrumentType
  ProductID
  TESminStep
  LegPriceEntry
  MinLotSize
  AllowAutoApproval
  AllowBroker
  NonDisclosureLimit
  PriceValidationRule
  MinExpiryRange
  MaxTrader
}

  date: Date
  """list of TESProfiles items."""
  data: [TESProfiles]

"""TradingHours query provides information about on-book and off-book trading hours per product in local Frankfurt time"""
type TradingHours {
  """Product symbol"""
  Product: String
  """Start time of the continuous trading (Format "HH:mm:ss")"""
  StartContinuousTrading: Time
  """Start time of the trade entry service (TES)"""
  StartTES: Time
  """Last trading day end time of the trade entry service (TES) for the front month contracts (Format "HH:mm:ss")"""
  LTDTES: Time
  """Last trading day end time of the continuous trading for the front month contracts (Format "HH:mm:ss")"""
  LTDBook: Time
  """ID of the product"""
  ProductID: Int
  """End time of the continuous trading (Format "HH:mm:ss")"""
  EndContinuousTrading: Time
  """End time of the closing auction (Format "HH:mm:ss")"""
  EndClosingAuction: Time
  """End time of of the trade entry service (TES)"""
  EndTES: Time
  """End time of the opening auction (Format "HH:mm:ss")"""
  EndOpeningAuction: Time
}
```
